name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: 5wCal double-tap event diagnostic: temporarily extend the calendar double-tap window from 400 ms to 700 ms and add distinct haptic acknowledgements. The first calendar touch gives a short 60 ms buzz; a second touch received within 700 ms gives a longer 150 ms buzz before selecting the first-tap date. This distinguishes a timing-window problem from failure to receive the second touch event.
